onenight.title: Une nuit
onenight.kicker: One night ashore · pick the quarter nearest your hotel or your car · in the order you walk it
onenight.lede: Girona eats early for Spain and shuts early: most kitchens take the last order between 22:00 and 22:30, and after 23:00 only a pintxo counter and a jazz cellar are left. Each quarter below is one evening on foot — the walk or the drink, the table, the last stop — every one from this guide, re-checked on 20 October 2026. Few houses publish autumn hours: call before you go.
onenight.door_en: Crew ashore for one evening: a plan for each quarter — the walk, the table, the last stop, in the order you take them.
onenight.door_note: Le verre · la table · le dernier verre

quarters.name: Barri Vell · Cort Reial
quarters.line: The xuixo's street at dusk, the old inn under its vaults, pintxos to midnight and jazz after.

steps.name: Cathedral to Sant Feliu
steps.text: Climb the stone spine while the light goes off the cathedral steps, then drop down the lanes towards Cort Reial.

steps.name: Fonda Cal Ros
steps.text: The Gascons family's fonda under the vaults: the rice baked in its tin, the roast-meat canelons, Empordà wine from the porró. Book; no current hours were found, and the old record says it shuts Tuesday and Wednesday.

steps.name: Zanpanzar
steps.text: Three doors down, the Basque counter keeps its trays moving until midnight; walk in, take what passes, pay by the toothpick.

steps.name: Sunset Jazz Club
steps.text: Five minutes away, the vaulted cellar stays open past one (no Wednesday in its posted hours). No kitchen: eat before you go.

quarters.after: Cheaper: make the whole night [[venue:v36-zanpanzar|Zanpanzar]]. Spend more: book [[venue:v03-divinum|Divinum]] across the river instead of the fonda.

quarters.name: The Call · Calderers and Sant Feliu
quarters.line: The Jewish quarter at the quiet hour, an ex-Celler bistro, and the late braves under the basilica.

steps.name: The Call, lane by lane
steps.text: Turn off Carrer de la Força once the day's groups have gone; forty-five minutes of steps and passages, slippery after rain.

steps.name: Dit i Fet
steps.text: Old Catalan cooking by a cook and a host from El Celler: the veal-tail croquettes, cap i pota. About thirty-five seats; book. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday, kitchen to 22:30.

steps.name: König, Calderers
steps.text: A plate of braves on the terrace under Sant Feliu's steps; it closes at 23:00 (23:30 Friday and Saturday) by its own site in July.

quarters.after: Instead of Dit i Fet: the Japanese kitchen round the 1900 garden at [[venue:v33-nomo-girona|Nomo]], on the Pujada de la Mercè, books online and serves until late.

quarters.name: Plaça del Vi · Plaça de l'Oli
quarters.line: Thick chocolate under the arcades, natural wine by the town hall, the brothers' plain bistro as the other choice.

steps.name: Xocolateria l'Antiga
steps.text: A suïssa at a marble table under the arcades, open to 21:00 most days; its Sunday hours are unreliable.

steps.name: SAFO
steps.text: Share plates that cross Catalonia with Mexico, and Víctor Martín's natural wines; dinner Tuesday to Saturday out of summer, kitchen to 22:00.

steps.name: Sunset Jazz Club
steps.text: Down the hill towards the Barca, the jazz cellar for the last glass.

quarters.after: The other table: [[venue:v04-normal|Normal]] on Plaça de l'Oli, the Rocas' mother's dishes; it books ninety days out, so plan it.

quarters.name: Mercadal · across the river
quarters.line: The bridges at golden hour, a vermouth on the big square, and the 1892 house that still cooks like it.

steps.name: The Onyar bridges
steps.text: Start at the Pont de les Peixateries Velles and zig-zag the footbridges while the river houses take the last light: about forty minutes.

steps.name: A vermouth under the arcades
steps.ref: card:Dinner on the Plaça de la Independència
steps.text: Have the drink on the Plaça de la Independència, not the dinner: the terraces are priced for the view.

steps.name: Casa Marieta
steps.text: On the same square since 1892: duck with pears, the canelons. Open daily on fixed hours, dinner to 22:30; book the arcade tables.

quarters.after: Spend more: [[venue:v02-restaurant-massana|Massana]] in the next street, the 1986 duck, booked days ahead; or the sommelier's vault at [[venue:v03-divinum|Divinum]].

quarters.name: Beyond the walls · by taxi
quarters.line: Not a quarter you walk: the fort above the city, or the three stars in Taialà.

steps.name: Esperit Roca
steps.text: Ten kilometres north, by taxi up the hill: El Celler's back catalogue in an 1893 fort. Dinner Thursday to Saturday, 19:30 to 21:30; the old record gives a closure from 3 to 11 November 2026. Book about ninety days ahead.

steps.name: El Celler de Can Roca
steps.text: Or the mothership in Taialà, dinner Tuesday to Saturday by the MICHELIN listing, booked online up to eleven months ahead. A taxi each way.

quarters.after: There is nothing to walk to afterwards out here: take the taxi back to [[venue:v42-sunset-jazz-club|Sunset Jazz Club]] if the night is not over.

getaway.title: Le week-end
getaway.door_en: Friday night to Sunday afternoon: the bridges at dusk, a sommelier's vault, the market and the stone, three stars in Taialà, and Sunday lunch in a fort.
getaway.door_note: Le pont · la pierre · les Roca
getaway.kicker: The getaway weekend · Friday night to Sunday afternoon
getaway.lede: Girona sells itself as a day trip from Barcelona: the cathedral steps, the coloured houses, an hour in the Call. The weekend worth having is the city after the day-trippers' train has gone — the bridges at dusk, the market at nine, the walls in late light — and the one family that cooks at every rung of it, from a cone in the street to the three stars in Taialà. It is all on foot except two taxis. Every stop is in this guide, checked in October 2026; few houses publish autumn hours, so book and phone everything.
book: [[venue:v01-el-celler-de-can-roca|El Celler de Can Roca]] — online only; dates open up to eleven months ahead at midnight on the 1st of each month and fill fast: book the table first, then the flights
[[venue:v21-esperit-roca|Esperit Roca]] — about ninety days ahead, for Sunday lunch
[[venue:v03-divinum|Divinum]] — a few days ahead, for the Friday
[[venue:v07-can-marques|Can Marquès]] — advisable for a Saturday lunch

stops.name: The Onyar bridges
stops.text: Walk the footbridges from the old fish bridge as the river houses light up, with the cathedral rising behind them.
stops.meta: Pont de les Peixateries Velles · about 40 minutes · free

stops.name: Dinner at Divinum
stops.text: Below street level in the old Casino, a star won from the dining room: the tartare finished at the table and the sommelier's pairing. Easy to walk past the door.
stops.meta: Carrer de l'Albareda 7 · closed Sunday and Monday · book a few days ahead; no 2026 menu price found

stops.name: Sunset Jazz Club
stops.text: Back across the river, the vaulted cellar on a DownBeat list; on Fridays it stays open to 03:00 by its posted spring hours.
stops.meta: Carrer de Jaume Pons i Martí 12 · walk-in · drinks only

days.label: Saturday
days.title: The market, the stone, the three stars

stops.name: Mercat del Lleó
stops.text: The 1944 covered market at its best: the day-boat fish, the sweet botifarra on the charcuterie stalls, the Girona apples.
stops.meta: Plaça Calvet i Rubalcaba · mornings to about 14:00 · closed Sunday

stops.name: Girona Cathedral
stops.text: Up the ninety steps at opening and into the one-span nave before the groups arrive.

stops.name: The Call and its museum
stops.text: Walk the lanes of the Call down from the cathedral, and end in the museum of Jewish Girona at the Centre Bonastruc ça Porta.

stops.name: Lunch at Can Marquès
stops.text: Opposite the market it shops from, the 1920 house: the salt cod with samfaina, the botifarra torn open under brie, whatever the stalls sold.
stops.meta: Plaça Calvet i Rubalcaba 3 · lunch Monday to Saturday · set lunch about €14.50 (Time Out, undated)

stops.name: Passeig de la Muralla
stops.text: The rampart walk from the Jardins dels Alemanys, up the towers for the roofs, as the stone warms.

stops.name: A panet at Rocambolesc
stops.text: Jordi Roca's gelato in a hot brioche, the walk-in rung of the family ladder; its hours and even its address differ between listings.
stops.meta: Carrer de Santa Clara · walk-in · about €4-8 (seen Jul 2026)

stops.name: Dinner at El Celler de Can Roca
stops.text: The table you booked eleven months ago, in Taialà, forty years old this October. Take a taxi both ways.
stops.meta: Carrer de Can Sunyer 48 · dinner Tuesday to Saturday (MICHELIN listing) · no 2026 price found

days.label: Sunday
days.title: The xuixo, the abbey, the fort

stops.name: A xuixo at Can Castelló
stops.text: The shop that fries nothing else: the crema xuixo, warm, sugar on your fingers in Argenteria. Not re-confirmed for 2026; check it is open.
stops.meta: Carrer de l'Argenteria 7 · open Sunday by the old record · about €3-4

stops.name: Sant Pere de Galligants
stops.text: The Romanesque abbey at the north gate, open on Sunday mornings, with the archaeology of the city in its nave and cloister.
stops.meta: Carrer de Santa Llúcia · Sunday mornings · about €6 (unconfirmed)

stops.name: Into the Vall de Sant Daniel
stops.text: From the abbey's square, walk the quiet lane into the valley for half an hour and back, the way the city spends its Sundays.
stops.meta: Plaça de Sant Pere de Galligants · gentle · free

stops.name: Lunch at Esperit Roca
stops.text: A taxi up to the fort at Sant Julià de Ramis for El Celler's back catalogue, Toda la gamba among it, under its own star; the view back over the plain is the last thing you take home.
stops.meta: Sant Julià de Ramis · lunch Friday to Monday 13:00-14:30 · closed 3-11 Nov 2026 by the old record · book ~90 days out

more.title: If you have only one evening
more.text: Take Cort Reial: the old inn's rice at [[venue:v09-fonda-cal-ros|Fonda Cal Ros]], pintxos at [[venue:v36-zanpanzar|Zanpanzar]] until midnight, and the jazz cellar after — three stops within five minutes' walk.

more.title: The grand night instead
more.text: If the Taialà table will not come, [[venue:v21-esperit-roca|Esperit Roca]] serves the same family's back catalogue for Saturday dinner (Thursday to Saturday), booked a season ahead, not a year; or [[venue:v02-restaurant-massana|Massana]]'s 1986 duck in town.

more.title: This October
items: The Fires de Sant Narcís fill the city from 23 October to 1 November — the correfoc in the Plaça del Vi on Saturday 24, the saint's day on Thursday 29, fireworks on 1 November: see [[card:The fair and the fire: Fires de Sant Narcís|the hot board]]; book every table
The clocks go back on Sunday 25 October: the bridges at dusk come an hour earlier
Tots Sants on 1 November is a holiday: [[card:Panellets and moscatell for Tots Sants|panellets]] in the pastry shops, and some kitchens close
[[venue:v21-esperit-roca|Esperit Roca]] closes from 3 to 11 November by the old record: phone

more.title: Where to sleep
more.text: This guide judges tables, not rooms. The only houses in it that let rooms are [[venue:v05-casa-cacao|Casa Cacao]], fifteen rooms over the chocolate house on Plaça de Catalunya, and [[card:Palau Fugit|Palau Fugit]], a restored Baroque palace in the Barri Vell; we have not judged either as a hotel. Sleep inside or beside the old town and the whole weekend is on foot.

more.title: What we would leave out
more.text: Dinner on the big square — [[card:Dinner on the Plaça de la Independència|have the vermouth there, eat elsewhere]]; [[card:The paella boards by the bridges|the photo-board paella]]; and [[card:Driving into the Barri Vell|the car in the old town]], where cameras fine the unpermitted.
